## Giant Seahorse (CR 2)

**XP** 600  
 N Large animal (aquatic)  
 **Init** +2; **Senses** low-light vision; Perception +13  

**Defense**

 **AC** 16, touch 12, flat-footed 13 (+2 Dex, +1 dodge, +4 natural, –1 size)  
 **hp** 26 (4d8+8)  
 **Fort** +6, **Ref** +6, **Will** +2  
 **Defensive Abilities** all-around vision; **Immune** flanks  

**Offense**

 **Speed** swim 30 ft.  
 **Melee** slam +6 (1d6+6)  
 **Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 5 ft.  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 18, **Dex** 15, **Con** 15, **Int** 2, **Wis** 13, **Cha** 10  
 **Base Atk** +3; **CMB** +8; **CMD** 21 (can’t be tripped)  
 **Feats** [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Skill Focus (Perception)  
*House rules: Dodge is part of Dodgility.*  
 **Skills** Perception +13, Stealth +7, Swim +12; **Racial Modifiers**, +4 Perception, +4 Stealth  

**Ecology**

**Environment** temperate and warm aquatic  
 **Organization** solitary, pair or herd (20–40)  
 **Treasure** none
